name: claude-notify-toast
description: Shows Claude Code notifications from Claude Notify Bridge as native desktop notifications on the machine you're sitting at.

commands.title: Claude Notify: Send a test notification

claudeNotify.when.description: Notify only while this VS Code window isn't focused, or always.

claudeNotify.windowsAppId.description: Windows AppUserModelID the toast is shown under. The default (Windows PowerShell) is registered on every Windows machine.
